name: Andrzej Buła, Younous Omarjee - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council RESTORE – Regional Emergency Support to Reconstruction amending Regulation (EU) 2021/1058 and Regulation (EU) 2021/1057
part_text:
The European Parliament backs a plan called RESTORE to help regions hit by floods and wildfires in 2024 rebuild. It lets countries use money already set aside for regional and social projects more flexibly, with faster payments and no extra national co-funding. Parliament accepts the Commission's proposal unchanged. It also repeats a concern: using regional funds as emergency aid risks weakening their long-term goals.

- Regions in countries hit by the 2024 floods and fires can redirect regional and social funds to repairs.
- Affected member states and regions get faster payments and full EU funding, with no national share.
- Parliament adopted its position; talks with member states on the final law come next.
